object_description: asymmetrical U-shaped volume around a mature tree grove
design_condition: The building follows the natural slope around the existing grove, linking the villa-and-clinic fabric with larger urban complexes while opening its layered facades toward the park.

positive.statement: The non-symmetrical U-shaped volume preserves the unique character of the sloping site and its century-old trees.
The simple and precise volumetry combines the typology of individual villas with the linear buildings of large complexes.
The facade expression creates a strong interior-exterior relationship through large openings toward the park.
The building follows the natural terrain with great delicacy and precision.
The exterior arrangements carefully integrate pedestrian paths around the large trees.
The sober architectural expression is particularly well chosen for the site and the program.
